instruction: Accessibility Clinic Renovation Report This task starts from init.ifc. Reference images are provided on the Desktop: init_plan.png, init_section.png. Modify the Archicad model as needed and save the required outputs as result.txt, result.ifc, result.pdf. Export result.txt as a tab-delimited zone property schedule text file from the Archicad schedule/list workflow. 1. The output folder contains result.ifc with size at least 500 bytes, result.pdf with size at least 500 bytes, and result.txt with size at least 20 bytes. 2. Result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema. 3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique. 4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcBuildingStorey entity and exactly 5 IfcSpace entities. 5. The IFC model contains at least 4 IfcWall entities, at least 1 IfcSlab entity, and at least 1 IfcRoof entity. 6. The IFC model contains spaces with exactly these normalized names: RECEPTION, WAITING, CONSULT, TREATMENT, WC-ACC. 7. Every listed space is assigned to the single IfcBuildingStorey. 8. The shaped IFC product bounding box is within 0.5 m of min [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] and max [13.0, 7.0, 3.2]. 9. Result.txt is tab-delimited and has exactly these headers in this order: ZoneNumber, ZoneName, Area, AccessibilityCritical. 10. Result.txt has exactly 5 data rows in this order: C01 RECEPTION 12.0 Yes, C02 WAITING 15.0 Yes, C03 CONSULT 12.0 No, C04 TREATMENT 24.0 No, C05 WC-ACC 16.0 Yes, with numeric values matching within tolerance +/-0.10. 11. Result.pdf has exactly 2 pages and extracted text contains at least these case-insensitive tokens: A101, A201, ACCESSIBILITY CLINIC RENOVATION REPORT, RECEPTION, WAITING, CONSULT, WC-ACC. Any item not explicitly required may vary.
